name: Lookout Cay True-True BBQ: Grilled Salmon, Red Snapper & Mahi-Mahi Station
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point · True-True BBQ & Serenity Bay BBQ
whyItWorks: Freshly grilled salmon and white snapper filets are high in omega-3s and lean protein when ordered without fruit/pepper salsas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Grilled Salmon filet plain without the pineapple salsa (avoid the lime-marinated snapper to protect the citrus guardrail) and pair with oven-baked sweet plantains or white rice.
watchOuts: Lime marinade on the snapper (choose plain salmon instead)
